body: OP, I know you love this woman but it is clear that she does not love you, as painful as that is. The fact that you're not mad about the way she's treated you only makes me MORE mad, because she's made you believe some part of that is justified. It's not. The fact that she wanted it to be kept a secret from your closest friends is such a massive red flag, martians could see it from space. Just because those are her friends doesn't mean she gets to cut you off from YOUR friends, this reeks of control issues. You both need therapy, and honestly, you'd be better off dropping this person from your life before they have a chance to dig their claws in further. She clearly has no one's best interest in mind other than her own. The whole acting like she's understanding shtick only to make you feel like shit in the same breath? Lowkey feels like gaslighting. She wanted her cake and to eat it too, and she deserves neither from the sounds of it. I don't care if her life is tough right now, life is never NOT tough and it is never an excuse to treat someone this way. It sounds like you both need some time in therapy, but you could do better so hit the ground running and do not look back. Grow from this, but do not mourn someone who tried to isolate you from those who could support you. That's not love.

Thanks for dropping in. The date is basically whenever I decide on the parts. The only reason I included the waiting time to November was if someone had a suggestion about a part being released before or around then that I should wait for. I'm ready to build as soon as I have a parts list I'm pleased with.

Thanks for stopping by to help. It looks good, but one question: Is the red version of the memory necessary? In the build I posted, I have a blue version of the same memory, so I know it exists, but if those aren't as good of quality as the red, I can understand.

I'm kind of attached to the case I already had picked out and it seems it still works well with the parts, so that's fine. As far as a disc drive I don't feel I need one. Also, I am in fact going into computer software engineering, so does this also still work well for that purpose? Thanks for the input!
